title: Chart
description: A complete, reproducible, language-independent Qimen chart.

calendar.description: Four pillars, surrounding solar terms and lunar date.

conventions.description: Explicit center-hosting, star and annotation conventions.

extensions.description:
Opt-in annotations and their named calculation rules; absent by default.
These never alter the base calendar or rotating plates.

input.description: The exact validated civil input and its selected calendar conventions.

leaders.description: Duty star and door with source and destination palaces.

palaces.description: The nine palaces, always in numeric Luo Shu order, one through nine.

pillar_voids.description: Void branches for each of the four pillars.

schema_version.description: Structural output-schema version, independent of the crate release.

xun.description: Hour-period head, hidden stem and void branches.

yuan.description: Five-day upper, middle or lower yuan.

yuan_head.description: Five-day 甲/己 head (符头) used to select the yuan.

AnnotationBasis.description: The pillar used for a chart-level branch annotation.

Branch.description: The twelve earthly branches in their traditional order.

BranchGrowth.description: One growth stage at one concrete palace branch.

branch.description: The actual palace branch; double-branch palaces retain both entries.

stage.description: Stage at that branch under the selected growth convention.

CalendarRequest.description:
Gregorian input and explicit calculation conventions.

Missing JSON `minute` and `second` default to zero, `utc_offset_minutes` to
480 (UTC+08:00), and `day_boundary` to `zi_start`. Unknown fields are rejected
so a misspelled convention cannot silently change the result.

day.description: Gregorian day, validated against the month and year.

second.description: Local civil second, 0–59; leap seconds are not accepted.

utc_offset_minutes.description:
Fixed offset east of UTC, in minutes, from −840 through +840.
Supply the offset actually applicable at the requested date, including DST.

CalendarResult.description: Calendar data required for a reproducible Qimen chart.

four_pillars.description: Computed year, month, day and hour pillars.

lunar_date.description: Chinese lunar calendar label for the input civil date.

next_solar_term.description: The following solar term, useful for boundary verification.

solar_term.description: Most recent solar term; equality belongs to this new term.

oneOf.description: Always host palace five in palace two, for both yang and yin dun.

ChartExtensions.description: Optional annotations. Absent fields were not requested, rather than negative.

day_horse.description: Day-pillar horse, preserving the base chart's separate hour horse.

door_pressure.description: Door-over-palace element control; excludes the reverse relationship.

growth_stages.description: Stem growth stages at each constituent branch of a palace.

hidden_stems.description: Nine-palace 暗干 with its construction convention.

strength.description: Star, door and stem strengths against palace and solar month.

tombs.description: Stem tomb annotations with an explicit convention and applicability.

CivilDateTime.description: An unambiguous second-resolution civil timestamp with a fixed UTC offset.

Conventions.description: Explicit conventions needed when comparing results between schools/software.

void_basis.description: Basis for the void markers on individual palaces.

Cycle.description: A stem–branch pair within the sixty-position sexagenary cycle.

index.description: Zero-based cycle position: 甲子 = 0, 癸亥 = 59.

DayBoundary.description: Civil-clock convention for the day pillar.

oneOf.description: Change the day pillar at 23:00, at the start of 子时.

Change the day pillar at 00:00. The 23:00 子 hour still uses the following
day's stem for its hour pillar, preserving one pillar across 子时.

DayHorse.description: Optional day horse, independent of the existing hour-based palace marker.

horse.description: Day horse branch and its palace.

pillar.description: Exact day pillar after applying the request's day-boundary convention.

oneOf.description:
申子辰→寅、寅午戌→申、亥卯未→巳、巳酉丑→亥, using the
calculated day pillar and therefore the request's day-boundary rule.

Deity.description: One of the eight deities, starting from the duty star's current palace.

Direction.description: Palace directions on the Later Heaven / Luo Shu arrangement.

DoorPressure.description: Door pressure for a single occupied door palace.

is_pressed.description: True only when the door's element controls the palace's element.

oneOf.description: Door element controls palace element; the reverse is not 门迫.

DoorPressures.description: Door-pressure results for all eight doors.

doors.description: Eight door entries in numeric destination-palace order.

at_month.description: Relationship to the solar-month branch's element.

at_palace.description: Relationship to the destination palace's element.

Dun.description: Yang or yin dun, determined by the current solar term.

oneOf.description: 阳遁, winter solstice through the start of summer solstice.
阴遁, summer solstice through the start of winter solstice.

Element.description: One of the five traditional elements.

ElementStrengthState.description: Ordinary five-element strength, used for doors and stems.

oneOf.description: Same element as the environment: 旺.

FourPillars.description: The four sexagenary pillars, with exact term boundaries for year and month.

day.description: Day pillar under the selected local-clock rollover convention.

hour.description: Hour pillar; 子时 begins at 23:00.

month.description: Month pillar, changing at the twelve 节 instants.

year.description: Year pillar, changing at 立春.

oneOf.description:
Yang stems progress forward, yin stems backward; 戊 follows 丙 and
己 follows 丁. Every branch in a double-branch palace remains separate.

GrowthStage.description: One of the twelve stages of stem growth.

GrowthStages.description: Twelve-stage results and the polarity/earth convention used.

stems.description: Every earthly/heavenly stem; hidden stems are included when enabled.

HeavenStem.description: A heavenly-plate stem, including its provenance and center-hosting identity.

is_center_hosted.description: True only for the palace-five stem travelling with 天禽.

source_palace.description: Earth-plate palace from which the stem was rotated.

stem.description: One of the three wonders or six instruments (never visible 甲).

HiddenStem.description: A constructed hidden stem in one numeric palace.

oneOf.description:
Put the hour stem at the duty door, then fly the nine instruments in
numeric palace order (yang forward, yin backward). If it repeats that
palace's earth stem, start at palace five. 甲 uses its hidden instrument.

HiddenStems.description: Nine-palace hidden-stem calculation and its actual starting point.

effective_hour_stem.description: Hour stem, with 甲 replaced by its period's hidden instrument.

palaces.description: Exactly nine records, in numeric palace order.

start_palace.description: Actual initial numeric palace, after the repetition fallback.

used_center_fallback.description: Whether repetition with the duty door's earth stem moved the start to five.

Horse.description: A travelling horse; its containing field identifies the source pillar.

branch.description: One of 寅, 申, 巳 or 亥.

palace.description: Luo Shu palace number containing the horse branch.

Leaders.description: Duty star and duty door, preserving the original center palace when relevant.

door.description: 值使门; palace five uses 死门 under the selected hosting convention.

door_palace.description: Current palace of the duty door, after center hosting.

door_raw_palace.description: Duty-door numeric flight result before center hosting; may be five.

original_palace.description: Earth palace containing the period's hidden stem, before hosting.

star.description: 值符星; this is 天禽 when the period's hidden stem originated in palace five.

star_palace.description: Current palace of the duty star, after center hosting.

LunarDate.description:
Chinese lunar calendar label for the supplied local Gregorian date.

This is the conventional Chinese calendar date conversion, not an
independent astronomical lunar calendar recalculated for the input timezone.

is_leap_month.description: Whether the month is an intercalary month.

oneOf.description: 时家拆补转盘: use the active solar term and five-day head independently.

Palace.description: All fixed and moving components of one Luo Shu palace.

deity.description: Moving deity; absent at the center.

direction.description: Geographic direction (the center has its own value).

door.description: Moving door; absent at the center.

earth_stem.description: Native earth-plate stem, including the actual center stem at palace five.

heaven_stems.description: Rotated heavenly-plate stems; two with 天芮/天禽, none at the center.

hosted_earth_stem.description: Additional center earth stem hosted at 坤二; absent elsewhere.

is_horse.description: Whether the hour-branch travelling horse occupies this palace.

number.description: Luo Shu number, one through nine; the output array is in this order.

stars.description: Moving stars; two with 天芮/天禽, none at the center.

trigram.description: Later Heaven trigram; absent for the center.

void_branches.description: Hour-pillar void branches contained in this palace; may hold both.

PalaceStrength.description: All strength annotations for a single palace.

door.description: Door annotation, absent at the center.

stars.description: Separate annotations for every star, including 天禽.

stems.description: Every earthly/heavenly stem; hidden stems are included when enabled.

PillarVoids.description: The two void branches of each pillar; palace markers use the hour pair.

Punishments.description: 六仪击刑 evaluations, with plate identities retained.

stems.description: Heavenly instruments are primary; other plate results are explicitly typed.

SolarTerm.description: One solar-term boundary in the request's fixed UTC offset.

index.description: Traditional index: 冬至 = 0, 小寒 = 1, …, 大雪 = 23.

start.description: Calculated start instant, at second resolution.

Star.description: One of the nine stars; 天禽 is explicitly carried with 天芮.

oneOf.description: 天禽, home palace five and hosted with 天芮.

StarStrength.description: Strength of a moving star under both explicitly recorded environments.

at_month.description: Relationship to the solar-month branch's element.

at_palace.description: Relationship to the destination palace's element.

star.description: Star identity, including a separate 天禽 entry.

StarStrengthState.description: Nine-star strength; 废 is distinct from the ordinary element's 死.

oneOf.description: The star generates the environment: 旺.
The star and environment have the same element: 相.
The star controls the environment: 休.
The environment controls the star: 囚.
The environment generates the star: 废.

Stem.description: The ten heavenly stems in their traditional order.

StemGrowth.description: Growth stages for one stem occurrence.

branches.description: Zero branches at center five; one or two elsewhere.

StemPlacement.description: Identity of a stem occurrence; hosted stems must not be silently collapsed.

is_center_hosted.description: Whether this is an additional hosted occurrence of the center stem.

palace.description: Destination Luo Shu palace, one through nine.

plate.description: Heavenly, earthly or optional hidden plate.

source_palace.description: Source earth palace; absent for constructed hidden-plate stems.

StemPlate.description: A plate carrying a stem annotation.

oneOf.description: Fixed earthly plate, including the explicitly identified hosted center.
Optional nine-palace 暗干 plate; included only when requested.

StemPunishment.description: Punishment evaluation for one stem occurrence.

hidden_jia.description: The six instrument's hidden 甲 pillar; absent for the three wonders.

is_punished.description: Whether the actual destination palace contains that branch.

punished_branch.description: Palace branch struck by this instrument; absent when not applicable.

at_month.description: Relationship to the solar-month branch's element.

at_palace.description: Relationship to the destination palace's element.

StemTomb.description: Tomb evaluation for one stem occurrence.

is_in_tomb.description: Whether the palace contains the tomb branch; `None` means not applicable.

tomb_branch.description:
Branch containing the tomb; `None` when the chosen rule does not cover
this stem (for example a six instrument under the three-wonders rule).

oneOf.description:
Stars use 生我为废、我生为旺、同我为相、我克为休、克我为囚.
Doors/stems use ordinary 旺相休囚死. Both evaluate the palace element
and the element of the solar-month pillar's branch (not lunar month).

Strengths.description: Strength annotations with the exact seasonal environment used.

month_branch.description: Branch of the solar-month pillar; never inferred from lunar month number.

month_element.description:
Element of the solar-month branch. 辰戌丑未 are earth; no implicit
eighteen-day seasonal-transition adjustment is applied.

palaces.description: All nine palaces in numeric order.

rule.description: Selected rule, distinguishing star strength from ordinary element strength.

TianQinRule.description: The supported placement of the central star.

oneOf.description: 天禽 and its center earth stem travel with 天芮.

TombRule.description: Supported stem-tomb conventions; these must not be conflated.

oneOf.description:
Use 墓 in the yang-forward/yin-reverse twelve stages, with earth
following fire. In this convention 乙's tomb is 戌, not 未.

Classical 三奇入墓 only: 乙→未、丙→戌、丁→丑. Other stems
are explicitly not applicable; this does not supply a six-instrument rule.

Tombs.description: Tomb evaluations; applicability remains distinct from a negative result.

stems.description: Every stem with explicit rule applicability.

Trigram.description: One of the eight Later Heaven trigrams.

Xun.description: The hour's ten-position period and its hidden 甲 stem.

head.description: 甲子, 甲戌, 甲申, 甲午, 甲辰 or 甲寅.

hidden_stem.description: 戊, 己, 庚, 辛, 壬 or 癸, respectively.

void_branches.description: The two unpaired branches for this period.

Yuan.description: The five-day yuan determined from the day's 甲/己 head.

oneOf.description: 上元: the head's branch is 子午卯酉.
中元: the head's branch is 寅申巳亥.
下元: the head's branch is 辰戌丑未.
